senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. Schr. KAT2, p. 583, ground, soil; bottom.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 31a:10">B. Mets. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אבידת ק׳</he> a loss to the ground, i.e. the duty of preventing damage to a fellowman’s ground through a stray animal.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:7">B. Bath. V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 84b:10">84ᵇ</cite>) <he>ואם היה</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>) <he>מחובר לק׳</he> if the flax was bought while standing in the field, v. <cite ref="H00107"><he>חָבַר</he></cite>. Ib. 4 <he>הקונה שני … לא קנה ק׳</he> if a person buys two trees in a neighbor’s field, he has not bought the ground belonging thereto.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 84b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>בעל הק׳</he> the owner of the ground.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:4">Y. Succ. I, 51ᵈ</cite> <he>מן הק׳</he> from the floor of the Succah.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 126:1">Sifré Num. 126</cite> <he>קַרְקָעוֹ של בית וכ׳</he> the ground on which the house stands down to the deep; a. fr.—

Snh. 74ᵇ אסתר ק׳ עולם היתה Esther was merely like natural ground (that is ploughed), i.e. in submitting to the embraces of the heathen king she did no act on her part.—Esp. immovable property, opp. מְטַלְטְלִין.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 11b:5">B. Mets. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>לקנות על גבי ק׳</he> to be acquired in connection with immovable property, v. <cite ref="A00235"><he>אַגַּב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 156b:2">B. Bath. 156ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קַרְקָעוֹת</he>. Y. ib. IX, 17ᵃ bot. <he>כשהיו ק׳ ומטלטלין וכ׳</he> when his immovable and his movable properties were in the same place.
<cite ref="Ketubot 87b:3">Keth. 87ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>שעבוד ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U01630"><he>שִׁעְבּוּד</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 15</cite> <he>קַרְקְעוֹת הכלים</he>, v. <cite ref="S02185"><he>קַרְקָרָה</he></cite>.
